title: Formal Authenticated-Encryption Security Proof for AOCB with Leakage Oracles
summary: The source gives black-box Priv/Auth bounds and a leakage-resilience analysis for AOCB, but leaves a full authenticated-encryption proof with leakage oracles unresolved.

formal_statement.body: A formal proof of authenticated-encryption security for AOCB in a model with leakage oracles remains to be established; the open task is to construct such a proof while explicitly accounting for leakage-oracle access.

scope.domain: Authenticated-encryption security analysis for the AOCB construction in a leakage-oracle model.
parameters: AOCB, the authenticated-encryption construction under study
Leakage oracles, the model access interface that the proof must explicitly account for
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct a formal proof of authenticated-encryption security for AOCB that explicitly accounts for leakage-oracle access.

progress.summary: The source presents black-box Priv/Auth bounds for AOCB and a leakage-resilience analysis, then identifies a formal authenticated-encryption security proof with leakage oracles as future work.
